description: This file is a shell script used for testing git-cvsserver and git refspecs, including functions for checking repository states, diffs, and various CVS and git operations within a test suite.

methods.name: check_start_tree
methods.description: Initializes a test for starting a new repository tree.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Checks if a specific file at a given version matches the expected content.

methods.name: check_end_tree
methods.description: Verifies the end state of a directory tree matches expectations.

methods.name: check_end_full_tree
methods.description: Verifies the full directory tree and git tree state match expected contents.

methods.name: check_diff
methods.description: Applies a diff file to a repository and checks if the diff results in the expected changes.
